changes.comment: When auto-start cannot open the launcher log for writing, for example because it is a symlink, a directory, a FIFO without a reader or a read-only file, a command now runs Rush in-process with the reason `rush-client: Launcher log cannot be opened for writing (<code>): <path> Using in-process Rush.`, as it already did for a log that is not a regular, unshared file. Before, it failed with exit code 1 and only the error text, such as `ELOOP: too many symbolic links encountered, open '<path>'`.
